labs.title: LLM Lab
previous_titles: MicroGPT: Generative Transformer Engine from First Principles
labs.description: Master large language model architectures from first principles using pure Python and NumPy. Build a complete generative Transformer engine covering token embeddings, probability distributions, multi-head attention, residual normalization layers, and autoregressive text generation.
labs.prerequisites: Basic Python programming (functions, loops, lists, dictionaries) and elementary arithmetic. Zero prior machine learning experience required.
